title: HVAC Maintenance Agreements Account Charges and Payment Timing Card
content:
Account-level charges and payment timing figures for HVAC Maintenance Agreements. The figures are the same on every agreement level: Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential, Standard, Plus, Dual-System, Dual-System Plus and Premier.

| Figure | Essential | Standard | Plus | Dual-System | Dual-System Plus | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment grace period, calendar days after a fee's due date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Booking hold, calendar days after a fee's due date | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Reschedule notice for a booked visit, hours | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Missed-appointment fee (USD) | 49.00 | 49.00 | 49.00 | 49.00 | 49.00 | 49.00 |
| Returned-payment fee (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |

## Definitions as stated in the agreement parameters

- **Payment grace period (30 days)**: calendar days after a fee's due date before nonpayment cancels the agreement.
- **Booking hold (15 days)**: calendar days after a fee's due date after which new visits and member repair pricing are on hold until the balance is paid.
- **Reschedule notice (24 hours)**: hours of notice needed to reschedule a booked visit without a missed-appointment fee.
- **Missed-appointment fee (49.00)**: fee billed when the customer misses a booked visit without notice.
- **Returned-payment fee (25.00)**: fee billed when a membership payment is returned unpaid.

## Order of the two day counts

Both day counts run from the same due date. The 15-day booking hold figure is the shorter of the two and the 30-day payment grace figure the longer, so for any one unpaid fee the booking hold figure is passed before the payment grace figure.

## Card questions

**How much notice does a member need to give to move a booked tune-up without the missed-appointment fee?** 24 hours.

**What is billed when a membership payment comes back unpaid?** The returned-payment fee of 25.00.
